skill.displayName: Free AI Photo Collage Maker – Create Instagram Collages Online with AI – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI collage maker — create a chaotic multi-media collage from up to 10 images

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-collage-maker-cli-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of AI-powered collage maker skill for the WeShop CLI.
- Create chaotic multi-media collages from up to 10 images using AI.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Provides a default avant-garde collage prompt, with customizable image input and prompt parameters.
- Outputs direct image URLs for generated collages.
